answer: Cloned coopers reuse one seasoning license to claim cask bounties. A run posts 29.3 POA at yard CY-14, takes 14-notch bung OC-81 onto drying terrace DT-6, seats it in cask CS-40 on ledge row LR-3, and presses timber-core wafer TW-11 to the bung within 48 s of a 6-bit kiln nonce on KH-9. Clerk calipers the wafer at 3.8±0.2 mm and matches notches to roster RS-7704; KH-9 logs the nonce plus two stamps. Shared bung codes slash both bonds 44% and freeze licenses 5 epochs. A late seat after 48 s voids the run and refunds 26.1 POA after 1 epoch minus a 1.7 POA late cut; a notch miss forfeits 8.6 POA.
